parts.zh: 官员称,周六Main Street一栋建筑发生火灾后
城镇记录显示该建筑内有四套公寓
M: 听起来确实符合我的口味
W: 我觉得最好先读书
M: 这个剧什么时候开播？我现在还有大量数据要收集才能完成论文
W: 我记不太清了。挺快的
M: 这主意不错。然后也许我们可以一起看这部剧

items.stem: Why did the six residents have to find another place to stay?

choices.text: Due to a fire alarm in their apartments.
choices.zh: 由于他们公寓里的火警警报。

choices.text: Because of the smoke and heat damage.
choices.zh: 因为烟雾和高温造成的损坏。

choices.text: Due to the water used to extinguish the flames.
choices.zh: 由于用来灭火的水。

choices.text: Because of the collapse of the three-story building.
choices.zh: 因为这栋三层建筑的倒塌。

items.stem: What does the news report say the Norwalk Fire Marshal is doing?

choices.text: Investigating the cause of the incident.
choices.zh: 调查事件的原因。

choices.text: Helping search for the suspect of the crime.
choices.zh: 协助搜寻犯罪嫌疑人。

choices.text: Rescuing the businessmen trapped in the building.
choices.zh: 营救被困在建筑物内的商人。

choices.text: Checking town records for the property developer.
choices.zh: 查阅该房产开发商的城镇记录。

items.stem: What have a number of past studies found about season of birth?

choices.text: It plays a less important role in one's health than nutrient intake.
choices.zh: 它对健康的作用不如营养摄入重要。

choices.text: It impacts people's health to a lesser degree than sun exposure.
choices.zh: 它对人们健康的影响程度低于阳光照射。

choices.text: It is associated with people's mental health conditions.
choices.zh: 它与人们的心理健康状况相关。

choices.text: It is linked with older adults' symptoms of depression.
choices.zh: 它与老年人的抑郁症状相关。

items.stem: What did the new study find about the relationship between participants' month of birth and symptoms of depression?

choices.text: It was indefinite.
choices.zh: 关系不确定。

choices.text: It was systematic.
choices.zh: 关系系统性。

choices.text: It was straightforward.
choices.zh: 关系直接明了。

choices.text: It was insignificant.
choices.zh: 关系不显著。

items.stem: What do the researchers' tests show about the cloned dog?

choices.text: It has helped solve several murder cases.
choices.zh: 它已帮助侦破了数起谋杀案。

choices.text: It has become a star office dog in Beijing.
choices.zh: 它已成为北京的明星办公室犬。

choices.text: It has surpassed its mother in performance.
choices.zh: 它的表现已超过其母犬。

choices.text: It has done better than naturally born dogs.
choices.zh: 它的表现优于自然出生的犬。

items.stem: What is the scientists' purpose in cloning police dogs?

choices.text: To speed up investigation into criminal cases.
choices.zh: 加快刑事案件的侦查速度。

choices.text: To test the feasibility of cloning technology.
choices.zh: 测试克隆技术的可行性。

choices.text: To cut down training expenses.
choices.zh: 削减训练费用。

choices.text: To reduce their training time.
choices.zh: 缩短它们的训练时间。

items.stem: Why does the news report say the scientists' goal is not yet possible?

choices.text: Cloning is too complicated a process.
choices.zh: 克隆过程过于复杂。

choices.text: The technology is yet to be accepted.
choices.zh: 该技术尚未被接受。

choices.text: Cloning is ethically controversial.
choices.zh: 克隆在伦理上存在争议。

choices.text: The technology is too expensive.
choices.zh: 该技术成本过高。

items.stem: How did the man get to know about the book The Three Body Problem?

choices.text: He read it somewhere online.
choices.zh: 他在网上某处读到过它。

choices.text: He heard about it from a coworker.
choices.zh: 他从一位同事那里听说的。

choices.text: He read an article reviewing it.
choices.zh: 他读了一篇评论它的文章。

choices.text: He watched a TV series based on it.
choices.zh: 他看了根据它改编的电视剧。

items.stem: What does the woman say she can't remember about the book's author?

choices.text: His publications.
choices.zh: 他的出版物。

choices.text: His first book.
choices.zh: 他的第一本书。

choices.text: His address.
choices.zh: 他的地址。

choices.text: His name.
choices.zh: 他的名字。

items.stem: What does the man have to do to finish his thesis?

choices.text: Collect a lot more data.
choices.zh: 收集更多的数据。

choices.text: Relax a bit less often.
choices.zh: 少放松一些。

choices.text: Clarify many new concepts.
choices.zh: 阐明许多新概念。

choices.text: Read more reference books.
choices.zh: 阅读更多参考书。

items.stem: What will the man most probably do first after the conversation?

choices.text: Find out the show's most interesting episodes.
choices.zh: 找出这部剧最有趣的几集。

choices.text: Watch the series together with the woman.
choices.zh: 和这位女士一起看这部剧。

choices.text: Get an e-copy of the book to read.
choices.zh: 获取这本书的电子版来阅读。

choices.text: Check to see when the show starts.
choices.zh: 查看这部剧什么时候开始播出。

items.stem: Why does the woman call the man?

choices.text: To check the prices of his farm produce.
choices.zh: 查看他农场产品的价格。

choices.text: To ask the way to the Newcastle City Hall.
choices.zh: 询问去Newcastle市政厅的路。

choices.text: To inquire about the vegetarian food festival.
choices.zh: 询问素食美食节的相关情况。

choices.text: To seek the man's help with her work on the farm.
choices.zh: 寻求男士在农场工作方面的帮助。

items.stem: What is the man still looking for?

choices.text: Bakers.
choices.zh: 面包师。

choices.text: Vendors.
choices.zh: 摊主。

choices.text: Vegetarians.
choices.zh: 素食者。

choices.text: Organisers.
choices.zh: 组织者。

items.stem: What does the man say they are getting close to?

choices.text: The issuing of certificates to vendors.
choices.zh: 向摊主颁发证书。

choices.text: The completion of the baking task.
choices.zh: 完成烘焙任务。

choices.text: The festival they are organising.
choices.zh: 他们正在组织的美食节。

choices.text: The deadline for application.
choices.zh: 申请截止日期。

items.stem: What does the man finally ask the woman to remember?

choices.text: The closing date of submission.
choices.zh: 提交的截止日期。

choices.text: The website of his company.
choices.zh: 他公司的网站。

choices.text: The details of the ceremony.
choices.zh: 仪式的细节。

choices.text: The organiser's address.
choices.zh: 组织者的地址。

items.stem: Why has wild camping become popular in the UK?

choices.text: Most scenic sites have been closed.
choices.zh: 大多数风景名胜已经关闭。

choices.text: Access to official campsites is limited.
choices.zh: 官方露营地的使用受到限制。

choices.text: Health experts advise going outdoors.
choices.zh: 健康专家建议去户外活动。

choices.text: People have more time during the summer.
choices.zh: 人们在夏季有更多时间。

items.stem: Why is camping banned for part of the summer in public parks?

choices.text: It is strongly opposed by nearby residents.
choices.zh: 遭到附近居民的强烈反对。

choices.text: It leads to much waste of public money.
choices.zh: 导致大量公共资金浪费。

choices.text: It has caused environmental concerns.
choices.zh: 引发了环境方面的担忧。

choices.text: It has created conflicts among campers.
choices.zh: 在露营者之间制造了冲突。

items.stem: What does the speaker suggest campers do?

choices.text: Look for open land in Scotland.
choices.zh: 在Scotland寻找开阔地带。

choices.text: Leave no trace of their camping.
choices.zh: 不留下任何露营痕迹。

choices.text: Avoid getting close to wilderness.
choices.zh: 避免靠近荒野地区。

choices.text: Ask for permission from authorities.
choices.zh: 向有关部门征求许可。

items.stem: What does the passage say about pink dolphins?

choices.text: They outcompete mythical creatures.
choices.zh: 它们在竞争中胜过神话生物。

choices.text: They usually mind their own business.
choices.zh: 它们通常不管闲事。

choices.text: They truly exist in the Amazon region.
choices.zh: 它们确实存在于亚马逊地区。

choices.text: They resemble alarmingly large snakes.
choices.zh: 它们看起来像大得惊人的蛇。

items.stem: What is the unusual coloring of pink dolphins believed to originate in?

choices.text: Scar tissue from dolphins' fighting.
choices.zh: 海豚打斗留下的疤痕组织。

choices.text: Skin infection from water pollution.
choices.zh: 水污染导致的皮肤感染。

choices.text: Unhealed wounds from snake bites.
choices.zh: 蛇咬伤后未愈合的伤口。

choices.text: Swimming along in seasonal floods.
choices.zh: 在季节性洪水中游动。

items.stem: What has become of the Amazon wetland system since 2018?

choices.text: It has been shrinking at an astonishing pace.
choices.zh: 它一直在以惊人的速度缩小。

choices.text: It has been placed under international protection.
choices.zh: 它已被置于国际保护之下。

choices.text: It has been appealing to both freshwater and sea dolphins.
choices.zh: 它一直吸引着淡水海豚和海洋海豚。

choices.text: It has been abandoned as a battleground for male dolphins.
choices.zh: 它已被雄性海豚放弃作为争斗场所。

items.stem: What do we learn from a new survey by Merrill Lynch/Age Wave?

choices.text: About 58% of young adults call parental support the new normal.
choices.zh: 大约58%的年轻成年人称父母支持是新常态。

choices.text: Most adult children enjoy increasing sources of financial support.
choices.zh: 大多数成年子女享有越来越多的经济支持来源。

choices.text: A full 70% of the young adults cannot afford to buy a car by themselves.
choices.zh: 整整70%的年轻成年人无法独自负担购车费用。

choices.text: Most early adults cannot sustain their lifestyles without parental support.
choices.zh: 大多数初成年人如果没有父母支持就无法维持其生活方式。

items.stem: Why did most young adults in the survey say financial support to children aged 25 to 34 is a bad thing?

choices.text: It renders them dependent.
choices.zh: 这使他们产生依赖性。

choices.text: It causes them to lose dignity.
choices.zh: 这导致他们失去尊严。

choices.text: It makes them mentally immature.
choices.zh: 这使他们在心理上不成熟。

choices.text: It hinders them from getting ahead.
choices.zh: 这妨碍他们取得进步。

items.stem: What did the respondents in the survey say regarding financial independence?

choices.text: It challenges one's willpower.
choices.zh: 它挑战一个人的意志力。

choices.text: It results from education.
choices.zh: 它源于教育。

choices.text: It calls for due assistance.
choices.zh: 它需要适当的帮助。

choices.text: It defines adulthood.
choices.zh: 它界定了成年状态。

items.stem: What is one big reason young adults are struggling?

choices.text: Current lifestyles.
choices.zh: 当前的生活方式。

choices.text: Poor budgeting.
choices.zh: 预算能力差。

choices.text: College loans.
choices.zh: 大学贷款。

choices.text: Emergency expenses.
choices.zh: 紧急开支。
